bridged_low_purity.text: The older occupation code behind the figures before 2021 mixed several different jobs, so those figures may not describe this job well.

bridged_soc2000.text: Figures before 2011 are estimated from the older SOC 2000 occupation codes using two ONS crosswalks.

bridged_soc2010.text: Figures before 2021 are estimated from the older SOC 2010 occupation codes using the ONS crosswalk.

category_level.text: Measured for a broad job-advert category, not for this exact occupation.

covid_year.text: 2020 figures are affected by the pandemic: low survey response and furlough.

cv_high.text: This estimate has a sampling error above 10 percent; treat it with caution.

employees_only.text: Covers employees only; self-employed and freelance workers are not included.

fallback_all_employees.text: Full-time figures were too sparse, so this uses all employees (full- and part-time).

imputed_parent.text: No direct figure exists; this is estimated from the wider occupation group.

mock.text: This is sample data, not a real figure.

multi_isco.text: This occupation spans several international job codes; the score is their weighted average and the range shows how much they differ.

ons_indicative_counts.text: ONS says its job counts are indicative, not accurate estimates.

partial_sources.text: Part of the data behind this figure was missing, so it rests on only some of the job titles or older codes.

pending_source.text: The data source for this figure has not been loaded yet.

provisional.text: This year's figure is an ONS provisional estimate and may be revised.

recoded_2021.text: Occupation codes changed in 2021, so job counts before and after 2021 are not directly comparable.

sources_disagree.text: Two research estimates disagree for this job, so the range is wider.

suppressed.text: This figure is withheld because the underlying data are too sparse or unreliable.
